sourceProject.name: Z80 tester
changes: Portable API and stereo transport
Copied MIDI parser: timed CC10 and SMPTE; source repository unchanged
SpessaSynth import rewritten to local pinned stb-vorbis.js
SpessaSynth CC123 releases keys through Note Off to respect the sustain pedal (MIDI 1.0 Appendix A-5)
Copied MIDI parser: no fixed per-channel or total note-count polyphony limit
Optional local voice DSP hooks: Hermite, filter, envelope gain, stereo/effect sends; scalar JS path retained
Structured scoped diagnostics for preset substitutions and unsupported MIDI/RPN/NRPN/GS/XG commands, independent of console logging; no DSP changes
Random pan RNG isolated per synthesizer for deterministic exact replay/seek; fixed 128-frame host quanta preserve partial-read state
Sequencer processes ordered trailing controllers and metadata instead of finishing at the last Note Off tick; PPQN tempo audio regressions cover acceleration, slowdown and seeking

Sequencer executes controller-only tracks and zero-duration setup files, applies timed port markers in event order, and initializes new-port channels with the same controller/preset defaults as port 0

SMF parser/writer preserve timed F0/F7 SysEx packets, escape bytes and End Of Track duration; bounded VLQs/chunks, correct running-status cancellation, extended headers and unknown chunks; per-port byte-stream decoder dispatches escaped channel/system messages and complete SysEx at final-byte time

MIDI 1.0/RP-018 Data Increment/Decrement with complete RPN/NRPN selection, per-parameter values and snapshots; RPN pitch sensitivity uses cents, MSBs clear old LSBs, live bend/modulation ranges update active voices, and RP-015 resets NRPN selectors and poly pressure without erasing parameter values
CC66 sostenuto captures per-voice key-down state only on pedal-on, preserves independent repeated notes, combines with CC64 and respects All Notes Off, reset and exact seeking

CC68 monophonic legato overlays channel mode, retunes existing sample layers without restarting DSP/envelopes, uses an independent portamento clock, and preserves per-key Note On/Off identities and sostenuto capture during fallback
Removed artificial 30 ms Note Off and 70 ms exclusive-class gate extensions; CC120 silences voices without consuming the sender's owed Note Off identities or changing pedals/controllers
CC69 Hold 2 freezes existing volume/modulation envelopes, preserves independent pedals and controllers, defers Note Off release until OFF and resumes ongoing release; native state stays synchronized

Note Off velocity preserved across SMF/F7, raw/scheduled MIDI, routed ports, per-key voice identities, pedals and events; Note On zero uses 64. Explicit preset response curves adjust release envelope times without reinterpreting SF2 sources or changing unconfigured banks. Forced drum release targets the owed Note On identity.

Host SoundFont part controls preserve ordered MIDI processing: receiver-port metadata, independent gain/pan and exact preset override, sample preparation, transport reconstruction and shared catalog/example UI; no upstream vendor changes.

Timed text metadata and shared lyrics/marker/display UI follow the real PPQN/SMPTE/port timeline; preserve original bytes, encoding and Channel Prefix semantics. Karaoke parsing no longer rewrites Lyric meta events into Text. GS/XG display packets are collected at final F7 and known LCD formats validate bounds/checksum.

Host rate/transpose and exact A/B transport preserve source-time coordinates and ordered commands. In-process synth/DSP checkpoints retain partial PCM, decoder, RNG and effect state without sample copies. Vendor RNG exposes state and sequencer accepts an inclusive loop boundary; default tick processing is unchanged.
Recognize native Yamaha XG SFX percussion bank MSB 126 alongside normal drum banks; unavailable SFX kits retain explicit drum fallback diagnostics.

GS effect DT1 extension validates checksums, ranges, all ordered payload bytes and partial EFX type writes; explicit unused/unknown parameter diagnostics. Added host overdrive/distortion models with Roland address/default maps, cabinet categories, mono routing, EQ, pan, level and sends; proprietary hardware transfer functions are not claimed.

XG System Variation stereo Delay LCR/LR/Echo/Cross Delay: complete Effect1 byte dispatch, 14-bit units and partial writes, validated parameters, CC94 stereo sends, pre-return/pan sends, unknown Thru and explicit unsupported insertion routing. Yamaha device numbers use the low header nibble; synth-owned JS delay state supports exact checkpoints.

XG System Reverb Hall/Room/Stage/Plate (8 programs), Chorus/Celeste/Flanger (11 programs), exact MU100 parameter maps/lookup units, stereo CC91/93 and serial Variation/Chorus sends before pan/return. Host FDN/modulation models keep all state checkpointable; default XG effect programs now replace GS defaults only in XG mode. Unknown types remain diagnosed Thru, reserved values remain explicit.

Expanded XG System-mode Variation to the exact 23 supported MSB/LSB programs: delays, reverb and Chorus/Celeste/Flanger. Variation reverb sums before input filters/ER; Variation modulation effects enable mid EQ while System Chorus retains its specified inapplicability. All first-ten parameters keep their 14-bit address representation with per-type ranges; checkpoints restore across family/type allocation.
Correct XG reverb density spacing against MU100 parameter explanations: higher density packs early reflections closer instead of only increasing their count; impulse timing regression.

XG Variation Insertion routes the selected part before volume/expression/pan, with neutral SF2 part-control audio sources, retained MIDI/modulator state, native envelope gain synchronization, proper Dry/Wet dry taps, per-part post sends and Dry Level. No Effect mutes without dropping voices; Thru bypass stays exact. Multi Part records consume every byte and support Variation selection and Rx OFF. Correct XG drum Variation Send default127 versus GS0.

Add XG Distortion/Overdrive with MU100 Drive/EQ/LPF/Level/Edge maps and published Effect2 Distortion default. Variation includes the specified gate; separate insertion does not. Enforce insertion delay-time and reverb-density ranges, and keep modulation mid EQ exclusive to Variation.

Implement two XG Effect2 insertion slots with independent part/control state, exact small/wide parameter reception rules, per-family ranges and INS1→INS2→Variation pre-part routing. MW/bend/CAT/AC1/AC2 target the published Control-dot parameter without overwriting base settings; unknown algorithms remain explicit Thru. Counterfactual drum/send decomposition and normalized controller interpolation are documented host policies. System On preserves Effect2 settings, All Parameter Reset restores them. Full histories and effective control values are checkpointable.

Replace incomplete MTS handling with exact fractional pitch, sparse tuning banks and independent per-channel RPN3/4 selection. Decode key/scale dumps and RT/NRT changes with atomic framing/count/checksum validation, no-change preservation, channel masks and receive/port routing. Active voices retain NRT tuning snapshots; RT changes and program selection retune without restarting phase/envelopes. Preserve MTS in snapshots/checkpoints, support sub-cent render updates and keep original fallback/legato targets separate from retuned sample selection. Dump requests remain explicit until MIDI output exists.

Implement a genuine SDS receiver and explicit sample-to-instrument bank adapter: exact8..28-bit offset-binary words, validated header/count/padding/XOR/sequence, duplicate ACKs and127→0 wrap, independent ports/devices, CANCEL and loop point edits. Completed waves and banks are reused through content-verified immutable caches; partial transfers/dynamic address maps stay checkpointable. sampleDumpMappings passes through public API, diagnostics, selective loading, Worker and host part controls. Incoming data changes new notes only; raw loop addresses are preserved and endpoint/envelope interpretation is an explicit host setting. Outbound transfer and later SDS extensions remain diagnosed.

Replace repeated full-pool scans with a slot-ordered active subset and min-heap of free indices, retaining first-free allocation and exact floating-point mixing order. Render/controller/pedal/pressure/MTS walks retain release tails and logical Note On/Off identities. Compact at render boundaries or before control traversal; rebuild on explicit caps and checkpoint restoration after pool growth. Reuse retained storage when auto allocation extends a temporarily lower cap. Verify against a linear allocation/traversal oracle, actual previous main PCM, sparse no-read instrumentation and paired performance measurements.

Batched C voice rendering with expandable descriptors and persistent native filter state; original voice/PCM order, final EOF captures and XG buses retained. Main stereo blocks with at least 16 listed voices use one render batch; sparse/legacy paths remain immediate. Growth, checkpoints, native/WASM/SIMD parity and exact reference PCM are tested.

SIMD128 f64x2 across adjacent independent voice filters: stable AoS state transposed into SoA registers, original feedback/Float32 accumulation order, dependent-memory fallback, sequential in-module oracle and pair counters. Native golden, complete PCM/state parity, 2053 voices, XG/controls/checkpoints and real before/after performance are verified.

Replace MIDI future-event and repeated-note front-removal queues with shared head/length FIFOs and amortized compaction. Ordered timestamps append without sorting; disordered bursts use one stable observation-time sort. Preserve every message, equal-time arrival, raw/port identity, Note On/Off matching, checkpoints and exact PCM. Embed the helper in standalone catalogs and measure future API, ordinary SMF and both note readers against the previous commit.

Explicit Web MIDI port lifecycle, validated timestamped output/Thru and separate live Worker/SoundFont synthesis with instrument sample readiness, preserved cold-load gate timing and shared catalog/example controls; file transport and C/WASM unchanged

Implement incoming CA-019 Extended SDS inside files: exact 28+28-bit rate fields and 35-bit arithmetic, interleaved 1..127 channels, ASCII/raw-tag names and wide loop points with atomic validation and bounded immutable waveform resources. A source-path oscillator implements all ten forward/backward sustain/release/one-shot modes with inclusive endpoints; native envelope/filter/batch/effect stages retain exact PCM. Stereo channel order and explicit higher-channel downmix, ordered file preparation, final-byte F0/F7, ports, held voices, Worker and exact seeks/checkpoints are verified against independent encoders, frame traces and actual audio reference banks. C/WASM sources, binaries and ABI are unchanged.

voiceDSP.scope: Main sample/envelope/filter/mix loops and GS standard chorus, delay lines and Dattorro reverb; MIDI/SF2 parsing, extended GS insertion and XG effect models remain JavaScript

changes: Paths adapted to standalone Player; ordered real MIDI dispatch selects key/velocity regions, linked samples, timed ports and F7 messages
Verified samples load before playback with cancellation, bounded encoded LRU and independent per-song decoded banks
Merge the MIT FluidR3 GS supplement without replacing GM presets or recordings; explicit profile mappings preserve MIDI state and report real source patches, with generated CSV/JSON address tables.
